company_info.company_description: Let’s look at some of the key reasons you should seriously consider having a Solar System, Batteries or EV Charger installed by O’Brien Electrical and Air Conditioning Warana.With over 345 - 5 Star Google Reviews from our clients - you know you're making the right choice!We have an established business premises on the Sunshine Coast with a Showroom at Shop 10/11 278 Nicklin Way, Warana.  Piece of mind we are not going anywhere.We hold all the correct licences for Solar, Electrical & Air Conditioning.We never compromise when it comes to safety.  As part of the Master Electricians Safety System our team are trained monthly on managing a safe workplace for ourselves and our clients.We believe in our quality installations and offer a 10 year workmanship warranty.We are Winners of the O'Brien Customer Service Excellence Award 2024.
